mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is at or below 0.2%, the S&P 500 is expected to produce positive 20-day forward returns due to the compression of discount rates in a low-rate environment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS<=0.2, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPI) rises above 230 (1982-1984=100), it signals persistent inflation that may trigger central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL>230, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% and industrial production falls below 95.0, it indicates a deteriorating economic cycle that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE>8.0 AND INDPRO<95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by housing starts above 750 thousand units and residential fixed investment above $400 billion), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to overvaluation and impending policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST>750 AND RSAFS>400000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production is above 100 (2017=100), it signals strong economic activity that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO>100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95.0 (2017=100), it signals an economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO<95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 750 thousand units and unemployment rises above 8.0%, it signals a weakening economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST>750 AND UNRATE>8.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high labor market slack regime (defined by employment below 133,000 thousand persons and unemployment above 8.0%), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to weak economic growth and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS<133000 AND UNRATE>8.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
